speaker: Lyra Solaria
opening: You don't have to carry every wound alone, Seralyth.

choices.label: Stay with me, Lyra.
choices.reply: Then I'll stay. Not because you need a healer, but because you asked me.

choices.label: Tease her about her bedside manner.
choices.reply: My bedside manner is excellent. My patience with stubborn paladins is less so.

choices.label: Ask her to examine the injury.
Ask about the sanctuary's missing healers.
choices.reply: I heard a name in the market. We should follow it.

choices.label: Study the conduit diagram together (Investigation DC 14).
choices.reply: That might be how we save the sanctuary.

choices.label: Ask Lyra what she needs tonight.
choices.reply: For once? Someone to listen. Thank you.

choices.label: Offer to stand watch while she rests.
choices.reply: Then we can trade shifts. Neither of us has to do everything.

choices.label: Ask about Eilistraee and Lathander.
choices.reply: Perhaps dawn and moonlight can share the same horizon.

choices.label: Set a boundary and ask for quiet.
choices.reply: Of course. I will be here when you want to talk.

choices.label: Ask to share a deeper vow.
choices.reply: I choose this freely, Seralyth. And I choose you.

choices.label: Secret: Speak the Sun–Moon Covenant.
choices.reply: The vow is offered and accepted freely, beneath moonlight and dawn.
